content:
Build a make.fun contest entry for user @Adnanhasim8 (GitHub login Adnanhasim8). Contest: gta6-trophy-guide-01 — "Build an offline web app that guides and tracks all 55 GTA 6 trophies: the official list with saved progress, filters and a spoiler setting, a roadmap to the platinum, and a guide to each that cites its sources". Prize $250 (top 50 share). Deadline 2026-11-21T11:00:00Z = 18:00 WIB today — finish well before then.

FIRST read the kit, fully: ~/workspace/makefun/kits/gta6-trophy-guide-01/gta6-trophy-guide-01-kit/RULES.txt, competition.yaml, kit.json, and the starter/ directory. Follow the kit's deliverable layout exactly (program/v1 harness). Build the entry in ~/workspace/makefun/gta6-trophy-guide/repo/ (create the directory; plain files, NO git init, NO commits — the parent handles git/init/push/submit afterwards).

You need the real 55-trophy list for GTA 6: research it on the web (official PlayStation/Exophase trophy lists — GTA 6 trophies were published; cite the sources you use in the app). If the exact official list cannot be verified, build the app around the best-verified list you can find and label sources honestly per trophy — do not invent trophy names.

TRANSCRIPT GATE (critical, a previous entry was rejected for failing it): write ALL code yourself in this session using your file tools. Do NOT paste in large pre-written code, do NOT copy code from other repos or earlier entries — the gate requires >=30% of counted lines authored by the agent in-session. Vendor any library only as a minified *.min.js under vendor/. Keep the entry within the kit's size caps.

Build a genuinely good offline web app: full trophy list with descriptions, saved progress (localStorage), filters (earned/unearned, rarity, type), spoiler setting, platinum roadmap. Verify by running it (Node 22 main.ts per kit) and rendering screenshots in a headless browser if available.

Do NOT spend money, buy API credits, or call any paid service. Do NOT submit anything yourself — build + verify only.

Report back when done: files created (with sizes), verification results, the trophy sources used, and any blocker. Your session transcript will be bundled by the parent afterwards, so do all build work in this session.

Done. Leonida Ledger: an offline static web app (no build step, no network requests) for all 55 GTA 6 PS5 trophies. Checklist with the official name, description and grade of every trophy, a checkbox saved in localStorage, per-trophy target counts, search, and filters by kind (story / side questlines / collectibles / activities / robberies / open-world misc / 100% completion), grade, earned state, and missable-only, plus export/import of progress as JSON. Spoiler setting ("Hide story spoilers"): unearned story trophies show as "Hidden story trophy" until earned. Platinum roadmap: 5 stages in PowerPyx's order, each with its trophies and per-stage earned count. Missables page: the one potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, Chapter 1 balcony meditation), 5 retryable one-shot conditions, and the 12 automatic story trophies. Sources & method page; every trophy's guide carries its own source links. Files: app/data/trophies.json (56,947 B, 55 trophies), app/index.html (9,463 B), app/style.css (8,979 B), app/js/main.js, views.js, store.js, filters.js (all written fresh in this session, no library vendored), main.ts (1,776 B), serve.ts, LICENSE (MIT), README.md, shots.json, vendor/makefun-frontend.ts (85,533 B, byte-identical copy of the kit's file), screenshots (4 JPGs 1280x800, under the 256 KiB cap, 13 trophies seeded earned). Verification: trophy data 55/55 names match the kit starter's official list exactly; descriptions match 55/55; grades 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze; names/descriptions also cross-checked live against Exophase (all 55 matched). Headless Chromium functional tests: ticking saves progress (13/55 shown in header); silver filter shows exactly 6; search works; export downloads the earned names and import restores them after a clear; spoiler toggle masks unearned story trophies; tabs, roadmap and missables render; zero console errors and zero non-local requests. main.ts runs clean on Node 24; two runs produce byte-identical dossier.json (sha256 85db8980). Dossier 684,656 B (cap 1.5 MiB); dossier text 100,522 B (cap 163,840). Sources: Exophase (official names, descriptions, grades); PSNProfiles (counts; returned HTTP 403 to the text fetcher, so counts were taken from the kit starter's frozen list and PowerPyx, cited as such); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (method, roadmap, per-trophy steps, paraphrased in my own words, never copied). The five trophies PowerPyx still lists as "currently unknown" say so plainly in their guides instead of guessing. No blocker. No money spent, nothing submitted.

Independent verification by the parent: README badges + make.fun footer added by the parent (the repo_readme/repo_about gate requires them); entry files present as listed; bundle, GitHub push and submit handled by the parent.
